'''Fanshir''' is an [[Asha'man]] Soldier.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Fanshir}}

==History==
He was a scholar before joining the [[Black Tower]].  He is a possessor of several interesting books.

==Activities==
[[Androl Genhald]] figures out the true identity of [[Algarin Pendaloan|Emarin/Algarin]] from a book of [[Tairen]] noble bloodlines, specifically that House Pendaloan had a history of men with an "unmentionable problem". This, of course, referred to the ability to channel [[saidin]] and with mention of the real [[Emarin Pendaloan]].

== Trivia ==
* Fanshir is named for Kevin Fanshier, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
